Project NUEVO

Built with a seven-person team, NUEVO is an autonomous rover that had to navigate a ramp-and-obstacle course, find its target, pick up a payload, and finish the route without manual control. I worked on the software integration and troubleshooting, connecting navigation, sensing, motor control, and the robotic arm into one system.

Robotics · Autonomous Systems

Autonomous Burger Robot

GoalBuild an autonomous robot that could navigate a maze, identify a target, and use a robotic arm to pick up and move an object.

ContributionDeveloped the control architecture for the drivetrain, arm, LiDAR, motor controllers, trajectory generation, and pickup. Implemented OpenCV vision on a Raspberry Pi and used FEA to evaluate the chassis before validating it with a 6-inch drop test.

ResultCompleted the full maze and autonomous task with the highest score in the class and the fastest completion time.
Bruin Formula Racing · Powertrain

EV Tractive System

GoalDesign and validate the tractive system's cooling loop and component layout inside a fixed weight and packaging budget.

ContributionSelected and integrated the inverter, HVD enclosure, pump, radiator/fan stack, and swirl pot; validated the cooling loop and packaged it all to hold CG and serviceability targets.

ResultA subsystem that passed every rules, packaging, and safety constraint and helped the car actually run — with a 20% strength-to-weight improvement on the FEA'd components along the way.
Bruin Formula Racing · Mechanical

Accumulator Charge Cart

GoalBuild a cart to safely store, transport, and charge the car's accumulator and battery cells between test sessions.

ContributionDesigned the charger mounting, accumulator retention, and a custom deadman-brake handle on a scissor-lift base.

ResultA safe, competition-legal way to move and charge a high-voltage pack — used as core support equipment at every competition.
Personal Project · Design & FEA

Solar-Powered Car

GoalDesign a lightweight solar-powered vehicle that balances performance, low mass, structural strength, and manufacturability within strict size and power constraints.

ContributionIterated the three-wheel rear-wheel-drive layout, designed the chassis and drivetrain in CAD, optimized the gear ratio, and ran static FEA to evaluate chassis strength.

ResultProduced a 53.2 g vehicle with a 2.35:1 gear ratio; FEA showed 1.319 mm maximum displacement under a 650 N load.
Personal Project · Algorithms

Ant Colony Foraging Simulation

GoalDevelop a MATLAB simulation where ants use local sensing and pheromone trails to explore, find food, and coordinate collection without centralized control.

ContributionBuilt the simulation architecture, implemented pheromone-based movement and exploration, and tuned decay and randomness parameters through repeated testing.

ResultThe colony collected 93 units of food on Map 1 and 259 units on Map 2, while testing revealed opportunities to improve exploration behavior.
Southern California Edison · Data

Gas Performance Visibility Dashboard

GoalGive operators a consolidated view of gas-utility performance on Catalina Island to catch cost and efficiency opportunities.

ContributionConsolidated multiple data sources, built mass-balance calculations to track consumption and leaks, and standardized KPIs into monthly reporting.

ResultSurfaced a 25% microturbine-efficiency opportunity and improved data quality and automation through direct integration with SCADA and Versify.
